{"outcome":"DIRECT_SUB_OPTIMAL","best_model_id":"PGS003972","confidence":"Moderate","rationale":"All 6 candidates are direct matches for abdominal aortic aneurysm by trait/efo and (where given) phenotyping_reported. {"outcome":"DIRECT_SUB_OPTIMAL","best_model_id":"PGS003972","confidence":"Moderate","rationale":"All 6 candidates are direct matches on trait_reported/trait_efo and use an abdominal aortic aneurysm diagnosis phenotype (PGS000753 is explicitly prevalent; others are generic AAA).
